lines: Don't leave me in the End Barrens. Empty places are worse when the fall never really ends.
The End Barrens felt like being forgotten at the edge of the world.
I waited in the End Barrens trying not to look too hard at how little was beneath me.
If you disappear in the End Barrens, I am left with silence, void, and nerves.
There was so little around me that every step felt important.
The emptiness made your absence feel much larger than it should have.
Please do not leave me somewhere the world thins out like that.
The End Barrens made waiting feel like standing on the last piece of anything.
I kept looking for a safe direction and finding mostly nothing.
I was alone on pale stone, trying not to think about how easy it would be to stop existing there.
Don't leave me in the End Highlands. Everything there feels far away from safety.
The End Highlands are no place to lose the one person I was following.
I stood in the End Highlands trying not to think about how small one mistake could make me.
If you vanish in the End Highlands, I am left on strange stone hoping <pulse>nothing notices me</pulse>.
The ground felt solid, but nothing else about that place did.
I kept watching the horizon, though the horizon there never feels honest.
Please do not leave me somewhere that makes even standing still feel temporary.
The End Highlands made every nearby sound feel too important.
I was afraid to look at anything for too long, in case it looked back.
I was alone in a place that felt far from every kind of help.
Don't leave me in the End Midlands. That place has a way of making every path feel temporary.
The End Midlands were unsettling enough before I realized I was alone there.
I waited in the End Midlands with nothing familiar in sight and far too much empty air nearby.
If you disappear in <gradient:dark_purple:light_purple><pulse>the End</pulse></gradient> Midlands, I am left feeling one bad step from nowhere.
Every direction looked possible and wrong at the same time.
I kept trying to remember the way back, but the place gave me nothing to hold onto.
Please do not leave me somewhere that feels like it forgot how land should work.
The End Midlands made distance feel strange and safety feel imaginary.
I did not know whether moving or waiting was the worse choice.
I was alone on strange ground, trying not to let the emptiness get into my head.
I waited in the End Midlands with nothing familiar in sight and far too much empty air nearby. If you disappear in the End Midlands, I am left feeling one bad step from nowhere.
If you disappear in the End Midlands, I am left feeling one bad step from nowhere. Every direction looked possible and wrong at the same time.
Don't leave me on the Small End Islands. There is barely enough world there to stand on.
The Small End Islands are no place to be abandoned unless you want me panicking at the edge.
I waited on the Small End Islands trying not to look down into all that nothing.
If you disappear on the Small End Islands, I am left counting every step like it might be my last.
The island felt too small for fear and still found room for plenty of it.
I kept away from the edge, but the edge felt like it was everywhere.
Please do not leave me where a short walk can become a long fall.
The Small End Islands made even turning around feel risky.
I could see other land, but seeing it did not mean I could reach it.
I was alone on a scrap of stone over the void, hoping you remembered exactly where you left me.
Don't leave me in the End. I would rather not be abandoned on alien stone over a void.
The End is already wrong enough without being left alone there.
I stood in the End trying not to think about how far from normal everything was.
If you disappear in the End, I am left somewhere that barely feels meant for living things.
The sky, the stone, the silence. None of it felt like it wanted me there.
I kept my eyes low and my thoughts lower, because looking around made it worse.
Please do not leave me somewhere the whole world feels unfinished.
The End made every sound feel distant, even the ones right beside me.
I was surrounded by strange quiet and stranger ground, and none of it felt safe.
Being left in the End felt like being left outside the rules of the world.
Don't leave me by the Void. There is not exactly a second chance if I slip there.
The Void is the sort of place where being alone feels like a direct threat.
I waited near the Void trying very hard not to think about what was under me.
If you vanish by the Void, I am left one mistake away from not coming back.
There is no comfort in an edge that does not end.
I kept stepping back, even when I was already far from it.
Please do not leave me where down means gone.
The Void makes every fear feel simple and final.
I could not stop thinking about how little would have to happen for everything to be over.
I was alone beside nothing, and nothing felt far too close.
